evidence: Changes CMakeLists.txt, depends/Makefile, and CI scripts to bump the minimum compiler baseline to C++23 (GCC 13, Clang 19).
rationale: Raising the minimum compiler standard to C++23 is a major toolchain transition that unblocks future work tracked in #34979 and removes accumulated compiler workarounds. The author notes that 'workarounds to avoid C++23 keep accumulating' and targeting C++23 allows the project to retire polyfills and align with dependencies like libmultiprocess.
